actions.reason: C0001 has coherent, strong biological support (large-effect metabolic/adipogenic pathway suppression with concordant 9p/CDKN2A-loss CNV signal), cross-modal membership support across all four modalities with positive fused boundaries to every other set, and no significant technical confounder association. Structure is compatible and no material unresolved question remains.

C0002 has coherent biological support (inflammatory/IL6-JAK-STAT suppression with a distinctive CNV pattern lacking 9p/CDKN2A/JAK2 loss), positive fused boundaries to all other sets, and no significant technical confounder. CT modality support is negative and internal reproducibility is lower, but RNA and CNV drive a defensible discovery-stage candidate; these limitations are noted as residual uncertainty rather than grounds for revision.

C0003 lacks affirmative biological differentiation: no significant RNA or CNV findings after correction, and three of four modalities (CT, RNA, CNV) show negative membership support. Although internal fused reproducibility is high, the candidate is not affirmatively supported as a distinct biological subtype, and no available evidence request is expected to reverse this.

C0004 has modest but coherent biological support (interferon upregulation, myogenesis/WNT down, chr6p/PTEN CNV signal) and positive cross-modal membership support with positive fused boundaries. However, membership is significantly associated with tissue source site and CT manufacturer, a plausible technical confounder that should be carried forward as a caveat; this does not by itself invalidate the candidate, so it is retained for downstream validation with explicit uncertainty.
